summary: Hongli Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Mr. Li Li as a director, effective June 11, 2026, and as a member of the audit, compensation, and nominating committees. The appointment is a routine board addition, not a forced departure, with standard director and indemnification agreements. No transaction terms, premium, or deal mechanics are involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, mapping to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02. There is no special situation; the event is a routine management change without extraordinary circumstances.
